decisions.statement: The camera is shown over whatever the app shows, full screen.
A tap on the shutter does what a press of the Action Button does.
A capture is taken only from a running session, so no blank frame is sent.
A press that finds the camera not ready says why on the camera and on a notice.
The picture leaves the phone at most 1600 across as a jpeg.
The camera stays up until the picture is sent, showing what happened.
A send that worked shows what happened, waits a beat, and puts the camera away.
A send that failed holds the reason up rather than putting the camera away.
A press after a send that failed takes a fresh picture rather than sending again.

definition: the Swift of the camera the Take Picture intent shows
